changelog: 🦀 Rust ContextCompactor: Chat history compaction, summarization prompt construction, anchor rule loading (AGENTS.md, .gemini/rules, CLAUDE.md), and rollover seed prompts are now ported to the Rust bridge daemon (POST /api/conversations/compact and POST /api/conversations/rollover-seed). Kotlin delegates seamlessly with local fallback.

🦀 Rust SmartModelRouter: AI model routing is now handled by the Rust bridge daemon via POST /api/models/route — 8-step priority chain (manual → offline → shell → security → coding → fast-QA → fallback → local), with Kotlin routeViaBridge() falling back gracefully when daemon unavailable.
